notes: Run 1 of the master plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-23-exhaustive-local-e2e.md (24 tasks, 6 waves). Wave 1 Task 1 (isolation harness) was verified green before this plan was written. Each worker gets a dedicated E2E_PORT to avoid vite webServer collisions; another session's dev server occupies the default port. Waves 3-6 (product domains, API matrices, billing/webhooks/workers, concurrency, responsive/CI) are follow-up runs.
